intent: DOCUMENTED NEGATIVE RESULT -- not a working fixture, kept because the failure is the finding. Ukrainska Pravda, 60:06, 4-person roundtable (AV1 1080p, 25/1 CFR, 90145 frames). shot-detect clusters it into 55 angles with no plateau and refuses to write a shot list: worst distance WITHIN an angle 0.0526 exceeds the closest distance BETWEEN two (0.0130), so a shot resembles another angle more than its own. Cause: every camera shares one black studio backdrop, so the background this method reads carries no signal; burned-in lower-third name cards make it worse by turning one camera into two. Masking the lower third and normalising contrast were both measured and neither helped -- the best margin of three variants was 0.47x where a usable one is well above 1.0. Telling these angles apart needs person identity, not appearance.

stage0_shot_detect._note: The refusal is correct behaviour, not a bug. Downstream this would have built one full-length tape per phantom angle.
